title: The Future of ERP
author: SAP SE
description: The Future of ERP explores the trends, innovations, and ideas shaping the future of enterprise systems. Through conversations with industry experts, practitioners, and business leaders, the podcast tackles some of today's most important questions: How will AI reshape ERP? What does modernization really look like? And how can organizations adapt and innovate in a rapidly changing world?
